# Rise Up Roofing & Construction

> San Diego County's premier roofing and architectural construction contractor. Master craftsmanship, Owens Corning Preferred Contractor warranties up to 50 years, and comprehensive residential, commercial, and emergency roofing services.

## Services

- [Residential Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/residential): Complete roof replacements, architectural shingles, and tile underlayment relayment.
- [Roof Repairs & Leak Diagnostics](https://riseuprac.com/services/repairs): 24/7 emergency dispatch, thermal imaging leak detection, and structural storm repairs.
- [Commercial Flat Roofing](https://riseuprac.com/services/commercial): TPO, PVC, and modified bitumen single-ply commercial flat roofing systems.
- [Solar Roofing Integration](https://riseuprac.com/services/solar): Seamless rooftop solar panel detach/reset and high-efficiency solar roof installations.
- [General Construction & Siding](https://riseuprac.com/services/construction): Exterior home remodeling, dry rot restoration, framing, fascia, and siding.
